table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invtype=2,
	itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	ModelDescription = item.ModelDescription,
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,    
	Phone= dbo.customer.phone,    
	cellno= dbo.customer.cellno, 
	email= dbo.customer.email,    
	city= dbo.customer.city, 
	RefNo = dbo.customer.RefNo,
	SpecialInstructions = dbo.customer.SpecialInstructions,
	CP = dbo.customer.CP,
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	ServiceInvCode=:ar_InvCode,
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	batch = saledetail.batch,   
	expiry = saledetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,   
	bonusqty = saledetail.bonusqty,   
	packqty = saledetail.packqty,   
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	salestax = 0,   
	Id = dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	custrefno=dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	remarks=dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	printwaranty=dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	printbatch=dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	reprintcount=saleledger.Reprintingcounter,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=dbo.saleledger.custcode,
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=saleledger.smancode),
	messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleledger.messagecode),
	reprintdate=getdate(),
	InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	CashTendered = serviceheader.CashTendered,
	CashCharged = serviceheader.CashCharged,
	CashBack = serviceheader.CashBack,
	CardsCharged=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentCode = :ar_InvCode AND CW.DocumentType = 'RS'), 0),
	DueDate=saleledger.DueDate,
	advancetaxamt  =dbo.saleledger.advancetaxamt,   
	FBRPOSFee=dbo.saleledger.FBRPOSFee, 
	fiscalinvoiceno = saleledger.fiscalinvoiceno

FROM 
	serviceheader,
	saleledger,   
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item  
WHERE 
	( serviceheader.serviceinvcode = :ar_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = serviceheader.saleinvcode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	invtype=1,
	itemname= service.name,
	aliasname=service.AliasName, 
	packingdesc=NULL,   
	ModelDescription = NULL,
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,    
	Phone= dbo.customer.phone,    
	cellno= dbo.customer.cellno, 
	email= dbo.customer.email,    
	city= dbo.customer.city, 
	RefNo = dbo.customer.RefNo,
	SpecialInstructions = dbo.customer.SpecialInstructions,
	CP = dbo.customer.CP,
	
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	ServiceInvCode=H.ServiceInvCode,
	saleinvcode = h.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = h.headerno,   
	date = h.date,   
	invdiscperc = h.discperc,   
	misccharges = h.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = h.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = 0,   
	gcode = NULL,   
	icode = d.servicecode,   
	batch = NULL,   
	expiry = NULL,   
	looseqty = d.qty,   
	bonusqty = 0,   
	packqty = 0,   
	packunits= 1,   
	saleprice= d.price,   
	discperc = d.discperc,  
	itemflatdisc=d.serviceflatdisc,   
	salestax = 0,   
	Id = d.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=h.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = d.serviceflattax,   
	gstperc = d.servicegstperc,   
	invgstperc = h.Serviceinvgstperc,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	custrefno=h.ref1,	
	remarks=h.remarks,
	printwaranty='N',
	printbatch='N',
	reprintcount=h.Reprintingcounter,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=h.custcode,
	salesperson=NULL,
	messages=NULL,
	reprintdate=getdate(),
	InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetServiceInvTotal(h.serviceinvcode), 0),
	CashTendered = h.CashTendered,
	CashCharged = h.CashCharged,
	CashBack = h.CashBack,
	CardsCharged=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentCode = h.ServiceInvCode AND CW.DocumentType = 'RS'), 0),
	DueDate=h.DueDate,
	advancetaxamt  =0,   
	FBRPOSFee=0, 
	fiscalinvoiceno = null
FROM 
	dbo.serviceheader h,
	dbo.servicedetail d, 
	service, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users
	
WHERE 
	( h.serviceinvcode = :ar_InvCode ) AND
	( h.serviceinvcode = d.serviceinvcode ) AND 
	( h.custcode = customer.custcode ) AND 
	( customer.custcode = accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( h.salesmancode = users.usercode ) AND
	( d.servicecode = service.servicecode )
ORDER BY 
	InvType, ID

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: if( invtype = 2, 'Detail of Parts Provided against Sale Inv. Code = ' + STRING(saleinvcode), 'Detail of Services Provided')

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: compute_18
objects.expression: sum((looseqty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc)) * (1 -  (discperc * 0.01)) +round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)
